chunks: Abū Ṭālib, al-Azdi, al-Baṣrī, al-Sha'rānī. He has a book that Muḥammad ibn Khālid al-Barqī narrates. Our companions said: This man is not known except from his direction.

key_terms.أَصْحَابُنَا: Our companions, referring to Shia scholars
key_terms.الْبَرْقِيُّ: Al-Barqī, referring to Muḥammad ibn Khālid al-Barqī, a prominent Shia scholar and narrator
key_terms.جِهَتِهِ: His direction, implying his specific chain or context of narration

ai.seo_question: Who is Abū Ṭālib al-Sha'rānī and how is he known in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This biographical note identifies Abū Ṭālib al-Azdi al-Baṣrī al-Sha'rānī as a narrator who authored a book narrated by Muḥammad ibn Khālid al-Barqī. The scholars note that he is primarily known through his own transmission chain, implying limited independent recognition outside of it.
